integrity: All infinite-sample claims follow from analytic binomial-moment identities and uniform Taylor expansions; finite enumeration is supporting evidence only. No independent external scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite multinomial occupancy only, with singleton and four-ball frequency counts. Classical moment and joint normality treatments precede the result; only the complete sharp sign interval and its square-root critical scaling are claimed. A relevant 1964 full text was inaccessible, so historical priority is not certified.
title: A sharp critical window for positive singleton–quadrupleton occupancy covariance
